name: Refraction
description: Light crossing from one medium into another: it bends by Snell's law and is partly reflected, as the refractive indices of the two media say

params.name: theta
params.label: Incoming angle
params.tooltip: Between the incoming light and the normal, -89 to 89 degrees; below 0 the light comes from the right

params.name: source
params.label: Light comes from
params.tooltip: The medium the light starts in

params.name: n1
params.label: Top index
params.tooltip: Refractive index of the top medium: 1 for air or a vacuum, 1.333 water, 1.5 glass, 2.42 diamond

params.name: n2
params.label: Bottom index
params.tooltip: Refractive index of the bottom medium

params.name: reflection
params.label: Partial reflection
params.tooltip: Also draw the share of the light the boundary reflects. Past the critical angle all of it is reflected, and that ray is always drawn

params.name: depth
params.label: Depth
params.tooltip: Height of each medium, above and below the boundary. The rays run to the edges of the media

params.name: normal_length
params.label: Normal length
params.tooltip: Length of the normal line on each side of the boundary, at most the depth

params.name: line_color
params.label: Line color
params.tooltip: Color of the normal line and the angle arcs

params.name: labels
params.label: Labels
params.tooltip: The angle labels, and each medium's index in its corner

params.name: label1
params.label: Top label
params.tooltip: LaTeX, for the angle in the top medium

params.name: label2
params.label: Bottom label
params.tooltip: LaTeX, for the angle in the bottom medium

animations.name: Shine
animations.description: Brings it in: the media fade in, then the light travels in to the boundary, bends and reflects

animations.name: Sweep angle
animations.description: Turns the incoming light to another angle; the bent and reflected rays, arcs and labels follow it

params.name: to
params.label: To angle
params.tooltip: The incoming angle it ends at, -89 to 89 degrees. It starts from the angle the light has
